overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee met to discuss technical cleanup of the Medford Zoning Ordinance and progress a proposed vacant building ordinance. The committee voted to keep the zoning cleanup in committee for further drafting while referring the vacant building ordinance to the full City Council for a public presentation.

items.title: Proposed amendments to the Medford Zoning Ordinance
items.summary: The committee discussed a tiered list of clerical and technical corrections to the zoning ordinance, including fixing outdated references and standardizing definitions for structures and dwellings. The item was kept in committee to allow staff time to finalize a comprehensive redlined draft for a target meeting date of April 29.

items.title: Proposed Vacant Building Ordinance
items.summary: Referred the proposed vacant building ordinance to a regular meeting of the City Council pending legal review and minor technical edits. The updated draft includes a tiered registration fee structure based on square footage, exemptions for properties with legal title disputes, and a plan to move the ordinance from the zoning code to the general building code.
